global_settings._default_note: The default ordering configuration as of 2026-09: LATA on, shelf-life clamp on, AMIT and MANDE reporting, DHARAM off. Ranked first of nine configurations on economic profit (GP - h*stock - waste, h = 14.38% CBK capital) at KES 138.4m/yr against 88.7m for the shipped baseline, over 15,739 SKUs and 12 seeded stores starting from the real stock snapshot. phi = 0.40 is ASSERTED: the volume-dependence of cv is confirmed on six months of real till extracts (cv falls 0.541 -> 0.268 across volume deciles) but its MAGNITUDE is not, so treat the cv change as a shape with an unresolved value.

amit.description: Assortment & Margin Integration Tool â€” One-In-One-Out GMROI gatekeeper
amit._mode_note: report | enforce. REPORT since 2026-09. A 12-seed, 15,739-SKU sweep from the real shelf put AMIT enforcement at -2.0m to -4.0m KES/yr of economic profit, and -30.2m for MANDE, because blocking lands hardest on high-margin lines. The caps are 26 authored numbers against 245 real departments. Set enforce only after the caps are authored and the blast-radius guard in amit_gatekeeper is satisfied.

lata.description: Lead-Time & Allocation Shield â€” Dynamic safety stock from GRN variance
lata._note: ON, and the reason the default changed. Measured PO-to-GRN lead spread plus review cadence from the receipt book. Worth +40.3m KES/yr of economic profit on its own -- 95.5% of that from 1,173 lines whose R fell from a calendar 7 days to a measured 1, which is FRESH MILK and BREAD. Ten SKUs carry 62.7% of the gain.

dharam.description: Demand, Halo & Revenue Analytics â€” Ghost Demand correction from neural graph
dharam._disabled_note: OFF, and not for want of code. Ghost-demand correction needs BASKET data -- which items crossed the scanner together, and when. This install has GRN baskets (what a supplier delivered together), which is not the same thing and cannot show a broken halo. Every POS database here is synthetic (MOCK_POS on 100% of header rows) and BILL_DT carries no time component, so 'milk sold out at 2pm' is not observable. dharam_demand_patch.json has produced 0 patches over 23,511 SKUs and the ablation measures its effect as exactly zero. Turn it on when real till-level baskets with timestamps arrive; the downstream wiring is built and tested and waits on the data alone.

mande.description: Market, Network & Distribution Efficiency â€” Quarterly Supplier Purge Reports
mande._mode_note: report | enforce. REPORT since 2026-09. Enforcing cost 12.9pp of service and 30.2m KES/yr of gross profit against a claimed 6.06m ONE-OFF capital release, and its SEI reads supplier revenue 69.5x low off a 162-day-old graph. The spec calls MANDE 'the hard data you take to the negotiation table' -- that is what report mode is.

config.notes: Strict Mode (global_settings) disables all category_rules and engine multipliers.

long_life._comment: Lines that sit in a fresh department but keep for months. Without an entry here they are treated as daily-fresh and capped near one day of cover, which removes any ability to hold stock against a supply disruption. OPERATOR-MAINTAINED: review the products list against the actual pack format before relying on it.
long_life._why_tokens_are_narrow: name_tokens is deliberately not broadened to ASEPTIC / TFA / TCA / LONGLIFE / 180DAYS. Those markings are reliable on a milk line but not in general - 'VARTA LONGLIFE POWER BATT' is a battery, and the long-life cap is TIGHTER than the dry-goods cap, so it would quietly reduce cover on non-dairy stock. Awkward cases go on `products`.
products: GOLD CROWN 500ML WHOLE MILK LONGLIFE FINO TFA 20

fresh_cycle._note: The daily fresh cycle, read by order_up_to.fresh_cycle() for every ordering path. Bread is baked and delivered the same day, carries a 6-day best-before on most lines (store-checked Sep 2026; one 5-day line was the first example) and is pulled a day early: 5 selling days. The extra day only binds on slow sellers -- fast lines are held by the one-day horizon at ~1.6 days of cover, well under the cap, so they stay fresh. Orders go in after close and arrive before the next opening, so the lead adds no selling days. Backtested over Apr-Sep 2026 against the bakeries' real deliveries (devkit/bread_backtest.py): loaf expiry -78% against the 3-day cover, availability matching the suppliers. Add real code dates per SKU under sellable_life_per_sku; they beat the department.
